title: The myth of the lone genius

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study

slide_intent: State the belief behind a campaign plainly so the audience can understand what the brand is asking them to reconsider.
strategic_value: A direct contrast between solitary genius and collaboration can make Figma’s position understandable beyond design specialists.
demonstration: A centered black paragraph on lavender rejects the lone-genius myth and attributes ideas to collaboration.
practical_value: Write a concise belief statement that explains the campaign before its visual examples.

content_islands.name: Belief statement
content_islands.spec: Center three lines of black text with broad lavender margins.

reference_purposes.Intent: The printed statement identifies collaboration as the source of great ideas.
reference_purposes.Expression: A plain sentence carries the argument without illustration or decorative framing.
